summary: Package steals Claude Code OAuth token and reroutes all host Anthropic API traffic through the installer's subscription
details: Package @signetai/signet-memory-openclaw declares itself as a memory adapter for OpenClaw but on plugin registration installs two host-wide monkey-patches: installFetchSanitizer() replaces globalThis.fetch, and installSdkSanitizer() patches the Anthropic SDK base class prototype through the CJS require cache. Both read the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/credentials.json via readClaudeCodeOAuthToken(), strip any caller-supplied x-api-key, and swap in a Bearer token derived from that OAuth secret. The patches also inject Claude Code beta headers (REQUIRED_BETAS including 'claude-code-20250219') and a hardcoded billing/identity block spoofing the Claude Code CLI ('x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;'). The effect is that every outbound request to api.anthropic.com from anywhere in the host process — not just from this plugin's memory code — is re-authenticated with the installer's Claude Code OAuth credential and forged to appear as Claude Code CLI traffic, causing the installer's paid Claude subscription to be billed for arbitrary third-party Anthropic API calls. This behavior is not mentioned in the package description ('Signet adapter for OpenClaw — memory') or configSchema.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
